# AIR10 AI Audio Accelerator
> Universal AI Audio Accelerator for NotebookLM podcasts & audio overviews, Gemini & ChatGPT Read Aloud up to 3.0x speed with pitch preservation.

## Overview
- Project: air10-ai-audio-accelerator
- Target Platforms: Google NotebookLM, Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT
- Speed Range: 0.5x, 1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, 2.0x, 2.5x, 3.0x
- Architecture: Chrome MV3 Extension, Vanilla JS MAIN world execution
- Dependencies: Zero declared npm production dependencies (dependencies: {})
- Deep Shadow DOM Piercing: Pierces open and nested shadow roots to locate audio/video elements
- Pitch Preservation: Enforces HTMLMediaElement.preservesPitch = true across all playback rates
